question: 5 closest countries to point 2.35 48.86 Paris km distance
sql: SELECT c.name, c.continent, ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(c.geometry), ST_Point(2.35, 48.86)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c ORDER BY dist_km LIMIT 5

question: nearest river to Vatican distance km
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name = 'Vatican') SELECT r.name AS river_name, r.feature_class, ST_Distance(ST_Transform(target.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM target, rivers r ORDER BY dist_km LIMIT 1

question: countries within 200km of Ob river
sql: WITH ob_river AS (SELECT ST_Union_Agg(geometry) AS geom FROM rivers WHERE name = 'Ob') SELECT c.name, c.continent, ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(ob_river.geom, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c, ob_river WHERE ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(ob_river.geom, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) < 200000 ORDER BY dist_km

question: nearest river for each African country km
sql: SELECT c.name AS country, c.subregion, r.river_name, r.feature_class, r.dist_km FROM countries c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r2.name AS river_name, r2.feature_class, ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(r2.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM rivers r2 ORDER BY ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(r2.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) LIMIT 1) AS r WHERE c.continent = 'Africa' ORDER BY c.name

question: 3 closest country pairs Europe km apart
sql: SELECT c1.name AS country_a, c2.name AS country_b, ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c1.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(c2.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c1 JOIN countries c2 ON c1.name < c2.name WHERE c1.continent = 'Europe' AND c2.continent = 'Europe' ORDER BY dist_km LIMIT 3

question: countries within 1000km of Tokyo 139.69 35.69
sql: SELECT c.name, c.continent, ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(c.geometry), ST_Point(139.69, 35.69)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c WHERE ST_DWithin_Spheroid(ST_Centroid(c.geometry), ST_Point(139.69, 35.69), 1000000) ORDER BY dist_km
